title: prep2go-exam-facts: Citizenship language exam facts (CIPLE, DELE, DELF, CELI)
description: Open, source-linked facts on immigration language exams (CIPLE A2, DELE A2 + CCSE, DELF A2/B1/B2, CELI 2 B1): format, pass rules, fees, official 2026 dates and who accepts them, plus citizenship/residency language levels for Portugal, Spain, France and Italy. Every value cites an official source; unverifiable values are null.
